executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains tight. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-25 reviewed 8 relevant current reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market with a lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
